questions.question: The article presents Pope’s line as “Chance is but direction which thou canst not see”, but *An Essay on Man*, Epistle I reads “All chance, direction, which thou canst not see;”. Restore the exact quotation or identify the current wording as an adaptation, and keep RU/EN wording consistent.
